rules: Expansion requires a reason and capacity; elapsed time alone does not create colonies.
A motive never overrides physical reachability, law, Prime Directive or settlement rights.
Colonization cannot be triggered by player arrival or immediate gameplay need.
Expansion pressure may create a proposal/candidate without guaranteeing authorization.
Terraforming-required targets need a real capability/project reference; Block 2 does not invent the technology.
Temporary scientific/mining/security presence is not automatically a permanent colony.
